verdict.rationale: Warp's docs give keyboard shortcuts for macOS (⌘+Y) and for Windows/Linux (Ctrl+Shift+Y), which implies the same desktop terminal runs on all three OSes. Warp also says it is shipping a settings file for programmatic control and easy portability between devices, which covers carrying the same config across machines. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of supported platforms, documentation of how the settings file syncs or behaves across OSes (it was only just announced), and independent hands-on confirmation of identical config across macOS, Linux and Windows.
